Open file in RStudio

Source: R/open_in_rstudio.R
open_in_rstudio.Rd

Function tries opening a file in RStudio.

Usage

open_in_rstudio(path, ...)

Arguments

path

(sting) Path to file.

...

Further arguments to rstudioapi::navigateToFile().

See also

  • fs::file_show(), browseURL(),

  • utils::file.edit()

  • usethis::edit_file()
